title: Melar SPAC merges with Everli Global
latest: Melar shareholders approved the business combination on Oct. 22, 2026; closing awaits remaining conditions.
sum: Melar Acquisition Corp. I, a SPAC, is combining with Everli Global Inc., an Italian e-grocery platform. The merger agreement is dated July 30, 2025 and was amended on Oct. 2, 2025 and Dec. 8, 2025.
who: A Cayman Islands special purpose acquisition company listed on Nasdaq, sponsored by Melar Acquisition Sponsor I LLC.
A Nevada corporation that runs an e-grocery technology and fulfillment platform in Italy.
why: The combined company would be named Everli Global Holdings Inc. and is expected to list on Nasdaq under "EVRL". Everli manages the logistics chain from online ordering to last-mile delivery for grocery retailers in Italy. The shareholder vote is one of the conditions for completing the deal.

history.t: Merger agreement with Everli signed July 30, 2025; amended Oct. 2, 2025 and Dec. 8, 2025

note: Closing is subject to satisfaction or waiver of remaining conditions.

title: Uber or DoorDash may buy Instacart
buyer: Undisclosed (Uber and DoorDash held early talks)
latest: Instacart explores a sale after preliminary talks with Uber and DoorDash, per a report on Oct. 23, 2026.
sum: Instacart is exploring a sale and has held early talks with Uber and DoorDash, according to The Information. No price or agreement has been announced.
who: Grocery delivery platform that went public in September 2023 and supplies technology to grocery chains.
Ride and delivery platform that partnered with Instacart in 2024; held preliminary talks, per the report.
Delivery platform that discussed buying Instacart in 2021; held preliminary talks, per the report.
why: Instacart's market value of roughly $12 billion is less than a third of the $40 billion to $50 billion DoorDash discussed in 2021, per Startup Fortune. That outlet's analysis says a deal would likely draw significant antitrust scrutiny. Orders rose 15% and gross transaction value rose 11% in 2025.

history.t: Privately valued at $39 billion; DoorDash discussed buying it at $40 billion to $50 billion.
Went public in September at a valuation below its 2021 peak.
Partnered with Instacart to add Uber Eats restaurant delivery to Instacart's app.
Held talks to buy Instacart; they ended partly over antitrust concerns.

note: Talks are preliminary; no buyer, price or agreement has been announced.

title: Stord acquires AMS Fulfillment
sum: Stord has acquired AMS Fulfillment, a third-party logistics provider, in its largest acquisition to date. The sources do not state a price.
who: Fulfillment network and commerce technology provider founded in 2015 that serves independent commerce brands.
Third-party logistics provider for premium beauty, wellness and high-velocity direct-to-consumer brands, with more than 20 years of experience.
why: The deal adds more than 10 million annual orders and facilities in the Los Angeles, Salt Lake City and Philadelphia areas, and takes Stord's network to more than 100 locations. It is Stord's twelfth acquisition, following Shipwire from CMA CGM, Ware2Go from UPS and Pitney Bowes' e-commerce fulfillment business. Stord said some AMS facilities already use automated put walls and sortation systems.

parties.name: Stord
parties.size: More than 100 network locations; more than 1,000 brands

history.t: Raised $250 million Series F in May at a $3 billion valuation and launched Stord Labs
Secured a $400 million credit facility led by Citi in October
Acquired AMS Fulfillment, its twelfth acquisition

note: Price and closing date not stated in the sources.

title: DHL eCommerce buys Venipak Baltic companies
target: Venipak Lietuva, Venipak Latvija and Venipak Eesti
sum: DHL eCommerce International Holdings is acquiring Venipak's Lithuanian, Latvian and Estonian companies. Lithuania's competition authority approved the deal on Wednesday, according to MLex.
who: Acquiring entity in the deal, part of the DHL eCommerce business.
Parcel delivery and freight transport company in Lithuania.
Parcel delivery and freight transport company in Latvia.
Parcel delivery and freight transport company in Estonia.
why: The deal covers parcel delivery and freight transport companies in all three Baltic states. Lithuania's competition authority has approved it. The source summary does not give a price, a closing date or the status of other regulatory approvals.
note: Based on a brief MLex summary; the full article was behind a paywall.

title: Duncan Solutions sells Pioneer Credit Recovery
sum: Duncan Solutions completed the sale of Pioneer Credit Recovery, Inc. after earlier 2026 sales of Pioneer Customer Experience and Gila. The buyer was not named and financial terms were not disclosed.
who: Provider of technology and services for government parking, tolling and camera-enforcement programs, founded in 1936.
Former affiliated business of Duncan that operated under Business Processing Solutions, LLC.
Los Angeles-based private equity firm founded in 2018 that invests in technology, business services and industrial companies.
why: The sale is the final divestiture in a restructuring that separates Duncan's transportation technology operations from its former affiliated businesses. Duncan, Pioneer, PCX and Gila were acquired by affiliates of Gallant Capital Partners in February 2025 through a carve-out of Navient's Government Services business, and the four previously operated under Business Processing Solutions, LLC. Truist Securities served as exclusive financial advisor to BPS on the three divestitures, according to the announcement.

title: UniUni to go public through MAK Acquisition

updates.t: UniUni agrees to go public through MAK Acquisition at about $1 billion
MAK sends UniUni a notice of material breach, starting a 15-business-day cure period
MAK terminates the purchase agreement; the go-public deal will not proceed

srcs.src: MAK Acquisition (GlobeNewswire, via The Manila Times)

latest: MAK terminated the purchase agreement on Oct. 20, 2026; the go-public deal will not proceed.
sum: UniUni agreed on May 15, 2026 to go public through a reverse takeover by MAK Acquisition Corp. at about US$1.0 billion. MAK sent a notice of material breach on Sept. 24, 2026 and terminated the purchase agreement on Oct. 20, 2026, so the deal will not proceed.
note: MAK said UniUni breached an interim covenant capping its cumulative pre-tax loss and did not cure it before the cure period expired Oct. 19. MAK is withdrawing its preliminary prospectus and will keep looking for a qualifying acquisition.
